methods.name: Score-based generative modeling via SDEs
methods.protocol_description: Define a forward SDE that smoothly transforms data to a prior by injecting noise, and a reverse-time SDE that depends on the score of the perturbed data distribution. Estimate scores with neural networks and use numerical SDE solvers for generation.

methods.name: Predictor-Corrector (PC) sampling
methods.protocol_description: At each time step, a numerical SDE solver (predictor) estimates the next sample, then a score-based MCMC approach (corrector) adjusts the marginal distribution. Generalizes SMLD and DDPM sampling.

methods.name: Probability flow ODE
methods.protocol_description: Derive an equivalent neural ODE that shares the same marginal distributions as the SDE, enabling exact likelihood computation and more efficient sampling.

methods.name: Controllable generation for inverse problems
methods.protocol_description: Solve conditional reverse-time SDE by incorporating the gradient of the log forward process, enabling class-conditional generation, inpainting, and colorization without task-specific training.

study_units.name: SDE framework for score-based generative modeling
